connectors.name: CBS SAP AI
connectors.description: Queries SAP Business One data on customers, orders, invoices, inventory and stock, and creates or updates sales orders, quotations, purchase orders, deliveries, goods receipts, invoices and payments.
connectors.use_case: Checking stock of an item across 3 warehouses, creating a sales order for a repeat customer, recording a supplier payment for last month's invoice.

connectors.name: fairyfly
connectors.description: Operates the user's open SAP GUI for Windows session, starting transactions, reading screens, tables and messages as structured data, opening value help, and filling and submitting forms with approval at the PC.
connectors.use_case: Starting a transaction to look up open purchase orders for a vendor, filling in a goods receipt form and approving the change at the PC.

connectors.name: mcpbizapps
connectors.description: Looks up SAP Business ByDesign customers, suppliers, sales orders and delivery status, receivables and payables aging, stock and project budgets, and prepares sales order changes that run after approval with an audit log.
connectors.use_case: Checking open receivables for a key customer over 60 days, changing the quantity on a sales order and sending it for approval.

connectors.name: SAP CAP MCP Server
connectors.description: Searches CDS models and CAP documentation for AI-assisted development of SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP) projects.
connectors.use_case: Finding an entity definition in a project's CDS models, looking up CAP documentation while developing a CAP project.

connectors.name: SAP Fiori MCP Server
connectors.description: Generates SAP Fiori elements apps from OData services or CAP in List Report, Object Page and Flexible Column layouts, lists Fiori apps and SAP systems, downloads OData service metadata, searches docs and runs functionality to adapt existing apps.
connectors.use_case: Generating a List Report and Object Page app from an OData service, adapting an existing Fiori elements app.

connectors.name: SAP MDK MCP Server
connectors.description: Creates, generates, validates, migrates and deploys cross-platform SAP Mobile Development Kit (MDK) applications and looks up MDK documentation.
connectors.use_case: Creating a new MDK app, validating and migrating an existing one, deploying a cross-platform mobile app.

connectors.name: SAPUI5 MCP Server
connectors.description: Creates SAPUI5 and OpenUI5 apps and integration cards, runs the UI5 linter and manifest validation, and reads API reference, project and version info, and development, integration card and TypeScript conversion guidelines.
connectors.use_case: Scaffolding a new UI5 app, linting a project and validating its manifest, following the guidelines to convert an app to TypeScript.
